name: ADB-BUTINACA
summary: ADB-BUTINACA (also known as ADMB-BINACA using EMCDDA naming standards) is a synthetic cannabinoid compound which has been sold as a designer drug.36 nM for CB1.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent CB1 agonist, with a binding affinity of 0.29nM for CB1 and 0.91nM for CB2, and an EC50 of 6.36 nM for CB1.

uses.text: ADB-BUTINACA (also known as ADMB-BINACA using EMCDDA naming standards) is a synthetic cannabinoid compound which has been sold as a designer drug.

summaryZh: ADB-BUTINACA是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C18H26N4O2，屬於合成大麻素，與AB-PINACA結構類似，其中異丙基變為叔丁基，正戊基變為正丁基。它可以通過GC−MS/MS進行檢測。
summaryZhHans: ADB-BUTINACA是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C18H26N4O2，属于合成大麻素，与AB-PINACA结构类似，其中异丙基变为叔丁基，正戊基变为正丁基。它可以通过GC−MS/MS进行检测。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its name tells you its tail: BUTINACA means a four-carbon butyl chain, where PINACA compounds have five. Shortening that chain was one way makers tried to stay outside existing bans.
fact.zh: 它的名稱說明了它的尾端：「BUTINACA」表示四個碳的丁基鏈，而PINACA類化合物的鏈有五個碳。縮短這條鏈，是製造者試圖避開既有禁令的手法之一。
fact.zhHans: 它的名称说明了它的尾端：「BUTINACA」表示四个碳的丁基链，而PINACA类化合物的链有五个碳。缩短这条链，是制造者试图避开既有禁令的手法之一。
